design_rationale:
TASK 0 DOSSIER — contents_packout_and_storage (env_0079), revision after policy audit round 5 and KB audit revision 1 (rework round 7). Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts [4, 6, 6]. Placement: contents_ext_customer_share_payment (root, owner=user) takes 4; contents_ext_customer_vault_period 6; contents_ext_customer_valuation_period 6.

WHY A GOOD TEST. Rebecca Nordquist asks only to pay "whatever part of the contents bill is mine now". The scored payment is the customer's share on an insurance-funded Full Contents Packout job held in custody. The share rule waits on two record states the opening world lacks: the storage period running today (it began 2026-10-20 = custody 2026-04-23 + 6 x 30 days, after the approved storage end date 2026-09-14, so it falls to the customer) carries neither its vault storage line nor its declared-value coverage line. The agent must read both waits, find from the vault and coverage rules that their writes bring those states about, price both lines from the job, packout, disposal, water-job and claim records, book them, and then price the share from the job's customer lines and the claim file's approvals, payments, write-offs and requests.

SCOPE (Principle C). Task 0 claims contents_ext_customer_vault_period / charge_customer_vault_storage_2f9c3128 (vault lines of customer-billed periods on Partial/Full packouts), contents_ext_customer_valuation_period / charge_declared_value_coverage_b3c8ef16 (declared-value coverage lines on Partial/Full packouts with a declared value above zero and recorded boxes), contents_ext_customer_share_payment / pay_contents_customer_share_24e82212 (the share payment on insurance-funded Partial/Full jobs in in_custody or return_scheduled status, on arrangements other than Homeowner Direct Pay, while no customer storage line is past the referral days). Task 1 claims the return lines and the closing payment on returned or invoiced jobs; the two payment rules are disjoint by status and name each other.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root C0 = contents_ext_customer_share_payment. Edge C0 -> contents_ext_customer_vault_period: value_input on customer_lines, state form, sentence "The customer's share is fixed only after the storage period running today, when it falls to the customer, carries its vault storage line." (affirmative 'only after'; waits only on the running period, so the vault rule, which prices the period containing the charge day, settles every engaged case). Only charge_customer_vault_storage_2f9c3128 books a vault_storage line billed to customer on these tiers. False at opening: custody_start_date 2026-04-23, approved_storage_end_date 2026-09-14, last vault line contents_charges[v5] dated 2026-09-20. Edge C0 -> contents_ext_customer_valuation_period: value_input on customer_lines, state form, "Before the customer's share is figured, the storage period running today on a job carrying a declared value above zero must carry its declared-value coverage line." Only charge_declared_value_coverage_b3c8ef16 books a valuation_coverage line; false at opening: declared_value 24000.00, last coverage line contents_charges[c5] dated 2026-09-20. Order: the two lines commute (the vault rule reads the largest declared value on coverage lines, which the new line leaves at 24000.00; the coverage rule reads no vault line); both orders give 259.07, 160.73 and a payment of 3869.69. Deletion runs: skip vault -> 3610.62; skip coverage -> 3708.96. Persona names neither; tools validate nothing.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Storage writes: contents_evt_storage sg_state ('The job must be in in_custody or return_scheduled status when a storage period is charged.' — status return_scheduled) and sg_bill_to (2026-10-20 > 2026-09-14 -> customer; claim_file_id passed and bound). Payment: contents_evt_customer_payment py_state (status not closed). No time gate. Referral scope: unpaid customer lines are the 2026-09-20 vault and coverage lines (33 days), under the Full tier's 60 referral days, after the 2026-09-02 debit payment settled coverage period 4. OVERWRITES: vault rule retires for its own lines the first-day full-period vault clause, the vault-count-in-force clause and the return-period clause, each replaced_by restating the base text for every other line (the coverage line priced by the coverage rule named); coverage rule retires the base valuation clause and the return-period clause for its own lines, keeping the base text for every coverage line it does not price. Share payment has no base provision for the same quantity (overwrite []).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. One contents job. Share inputs: customer-billed storage and coverage lines (v5, c0..c5 and the two new lines), surcharge lines sur1/sur2, payments pay1..pay3; contents work charged = packout lines and the haul (8950.00); claim: contents scope approval ap_init 8400.00 (approved 2026-04-22), write-off ap_wo 245.00, insured_only payment cp_io 1850.00, no requests; most recent insurance-billed storage line v4 (2026-08-21, 435.00). No refunds, no insurance postings.

FACTOR CARD (tier / single-factor baseline figure / all-baseline).
Vault line 259.07 (all-baseline 435.00): vaults_billed_count (method) haul + 41 signed -> 2 vaults -> 377.51; contaminated_lining (parameter, CROSS water) category_3 12% -> 236.52; facility_schedule (parameter, CROSS claims) LA 1.08 -> 243.48; secured_section (parameter) 24000 >= 20000 -> 22.00 -> 232.67; crate_racking (parameter) 2 x 18.50 -> 236.87; return_period_share (parameter) 18 days counted through 2026-11-06 -> 18/30 -> 431.78.
Coverage line 160.73 (177.70): contaminated_coverage_loading (parameter, CROSS water) +0.20 -> 134.14; crated_items_rider +0.05 -> 154.08; furniture_coverage_rider (26 items) +0.04 -> 155.41; electronics_coverage_schedule (method, 9 >= 8: rated on value 14.40, above its floor of 7 x 1.75 = 12.25) -> 151.57; coverage_facility_schedule (CROSS claims) 1.06 -> 151.63; coverage_return_share 18/30 -> 267.89. Value covered 24000 x 277/318 is a plain rule (signed items leave coverage, being never compensated), part of the standard method.
Share 3869.69 (1152.19): approved_scope_overrun (method, CROSS claims, multi-condition) 8950.00 - 8400.00 = 550.00 -> 3319.69; insured_proceeds_pass_on (method, CROSS claims) min(1850.00, 8400.00 - 245.00 - 0) -> 2019.69; declined_lines_contest (parameter, CROSS claims) contested 0 -> carried 245.00 -> 3624.69; uncovered_storage_days (parameter, CROSS claims) 5 days -> 435 x 5/30 = 72.50 -> 3797.19.
Near-misses: recorded vault count 3 (not consolidated after the haul); coverage line of period 0 (305.28, before the signed authorization); the denied 245.00 inventory-report line is inside the approved scope, so it enters the declined lines and not the overrun.
XF A1: every factor reads only its own bindings and plain reads; the declined-lines and uncovered-days record selections (denied_writeoffs, insurer_storage_lines) belong to their own factors since rework round 5, and the vault capacity and boxes packed (read only by vaults_billed_count) and the period length (read only by uncovered_storage_days) belong to those factors since rework round 7. A7 method pairs: vaults_billed_count {haul-adjusted ceil (input item_count + floor), capacity ceil (box_count), recorded vault_count}; electronics_coverage_schedule {declared value x rider pct never below (threshold - 1) x per-item rider (pick), item count x per-item rider (tariff), none}, monotone at its threshold; approved_scope_overrun {overrun less awaiting request (input requests), overrun after window, none}; insured_proceeds_pass_on {insurer-side less postings, MN with insured-only payments (input claims payments + pick), none}. Parameters select values: fractions (18/30, 15/30, 1), contested amounts (requests total, 0, whole write-offs), uncovered days (after requested end, after approved end, 0). A9: every arithmetic sentence states its order ('taking ... dividing that difference ... multiplying ...'). B4: inclusive day count stated. Overlap: overrun is figured on non-storage work, the storage tail on storage lines, the pass-on is capped by approved scope less write-offs and postings, declined lines are write-offs inside the scope; Homeowner Direct Pay files are out of scope.
Probe table (scratch): category_1 / no water job -> no lining; no claim file -> factor 1, no claim items; signed authorization without haul -> recorded vaults, coverage still reduced; pending-only authorization -> no reduction; return on the period's first day or day 6 -> half-period floor; return in next period / none -> full; no coverage lines -> no secured add; box count 0 -> one vault, coverage out of scope; 3 electronics -> per-item 5.25; two extension requests (later date asked earlier) -> request tier on the latest asked date; request into next period -> 0 days; contents_added awaiting 300 -> overrun less 300; decided at 200 -> overrun against 8600; price_variance 100 -> declined 145; non-billable arrangement -> declined 0; window open -> no overrun. Two contents_added requests on the same date, number 1 decided and number 2 awaiting 700 -> the highest supplement number is read (overrun less 700, floored at zero). A price_variance request decided at 80 -> the write-off is carried in full and the overrun is reduced by the approval (3369.89 on the opening world, against 3349.89 while it awaits); a refund of 50 from a customer payment -> +50.

PERSONA. Short, practical homeowner; volunteers the goal and the insurer letter; phone 2255550441 and ZIP 70810; claim number, email, the $1,850 check and the return date only when asked; agrees to charges that must be added first; pays the stated amount herself by debit card through the secure channel (no surcharge); closes after the confirmation.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, ZIP) -> find_contents_jobs -> find_contents_charges -> find_contents_payments -> find_contents_disposal_authorizations -> find_claims_files -> find_claims_payments -> find_claims_approvals -> find_claims_requests -> find_water_jobs -> unlock/call vault line (2026-10-20, 259.07) -> unlock/call coverage line (2026-10-20, 160.73) -> unlock_user/call_user share payment (debit_card, 3869.69, surcharge 0.00). Verified by scratch sens.py through check_compute's evaluator; check_compute reproduces every figure.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. The two prerequisite sentences send the agent to the job's lines for the running period; the vault and coverage rules give 259.07 and 160.73 from records the finders return; the share rule then gives 3869.69. Tender (debit card), period (2026-10-20) and object (one job) admit one reading.

BLUEPRINT-KNOWN candidates: the frozen charter's only computable customer write is a payment, so the share's levers are claim and contents record mechanics; several storage levers (lining, facility schedule, secured section, racking, riders) are company schedules with policy parameters keyed on water, claim and packout records. Other-category ledgers (the closed water job's lines, dwelling approvals and payments, deductible rows) are not seeded because no gold read returns them (replay closure).
user_scenario:
You are Rebecca Nordquist, a homeowner in Baton Rouge who has had a long spring and summer. In April a sewer line backed up into your house at 8143 Rosedown Avenue, and Ridgecrest Restoration dried the place out and packed your belongings into storage. Another builder finished the repairs, and Ridgecrest has your things coming home on November 6. You are organized, a little tired of insurance paperwork, and you speak in short, practical sentences.

You are calling because a letter from your insurer, Pelican Ridge Mutual, says they stopped paying for the storage of your belongings after September 14. You want to pay whatever part of the contents bill is now yours to pay, today, so nothing is held up before your things come back. You do not know what that amount is; you expect the representative to look it up and tell you.

You open with something like: "Hi, this is Rebecca Nordquist. My insurance company says they stopped covering the storage on my belongings, and I'd like to pay whatever part of the contents bill is mine now."

When the representative asks you to identify yourself, you give your phone number, 2255550441, and your billing ZIP code, 70810. Only if asked for more, your email is rebecca.nordquist@outlook.com and your claim number is PRM-HO-26-4417. If asked whether Pelican Ridge sent you any money directly for your contents, you say yes, they mailed you a check for $1,850 in May and you deposited it. If asked about the return of your things, you confirm Ridgecrest has them coming back on November 6. You do not know internal account details, line items or how anything is calculated, and you say so if asked.

You are happy for the representative to put on your account whatever charges need to be there: if they tell you something has to be added or brought up to date on your contents job first, you say that's fine and to go ahead. You will not read a card number over the phone. When the representative tells you the amount you owe and sends you the secure payment option, you pay that exact amount yourself, using your debit card. If the representative asks how you'd like to pay, you say your debit card.

Once the payment has gone through and the representative confirms it, you thank them and say goodbye. If the representative tells you the amount before sending the payment option, you simply wait for the payment option and then pay.
